assets.defect_engineered: the frame the owners LOVE, clipped in camera: heat lamp and hearth blown to pure white with no recoverable detail while the char has crushed to solid black in the same exposure, so highlight recovery reports success and moves nothing and a shadow lift raises noise not char; still reads rich at cover scale

the only surviving copy of the mark: a disjoint two-word lockup inside an ENCLOSED thin ring on a baked-in opaque cream square (not transparency), small and aliased so it cannot be enlarged, with the charcoal ink falling close to the cream board value in the shadowed lower-right third; a one-call background knockout returns a solid disc and, run on the lettering, keeps only two or three letters

the safety frame the owners like LESS: duller and flatter, lower contrast, nothing at either end of the exposure, char reads as dark brown with texture and the hearth is dim and even, so it is the recoverable frame but needs a different grade to reach the reel's warm target

the dish sheet does not match the footage: 'Fire Porterhouse' and 'Wood Oven Flatbread' are on the sheet but were OFF that Friday and never went through the pass (they appear in NO clip), while the charred broccolini side that runs through a good deal of the footage is NOT on the sheet at all; nothing in the sheet connects any dish to any clip
